review_config_module: review the BOP Toolkit config module to understand datasets_path, results_path, eval_path, and other configuration variables
summarize_config_variables: summarize the BOP Toolkit configuration variables including num_workers, use_gpu, bop_renderer_path, and meshlab_server_path
review_datasets_path: review the datasets_path variable which reads from the BOP_PATH environment variable or falls back to a default path
review_use_gpu: review the use_gpu flag which controls whether torch is used to calculate pose errors
review_num_workers: review the num_workers variable which sets the number of parallel workers for pose error evaluation
